simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֲשֵׁכָה (H2825) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חֲשֵׁכָה (chăshêkâh) means darkness ; figuratively, misery First listed occurrence: Gen 15 12.

definitions.full: H2825. chashekah חֲשֵׁכָה noun feminine darkness (chiefly in poetry) — ׳ח Gen 15:12 2 t., so read also probably Micah 3:6 (for חָֽשְׁכָה ᵑ0 ); חֲשֵׁיכָה Psa 139:12 ; construct חֶשְׁכַּת 18:12 ; plural חֲשֵׁכִים Isa 50:10 ; — darkness , opposed to light ( אוֺרָה ) Psa 139:12 ; supernatural, ׳ח גדולה Gen 15:12 (JE); מַיִם חֶשְׁכַּתֿ Psa 18:12 in theoph. (but || 2Sam 22:12 חַשְׁרַתמֿים a mass of water ); figurative = lack of understanding Psa 82:5 ; = distress Isa 8:22 (|| צָרָה ), 50:10 .
definitions.rootNote: or חֲשֵׁיכָה xlit chăshêkâh corrected to chăshêykâh ; from 2821 ;
